page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it lacks GPU acceleration. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the processor performance of the ecs.re6p.xlarge falls into the lower tier. The stress-ng single-core CPU test yielded a score of 1317.6, placing it in the bottom 25% of tested instances. Similarly, the stress-ng multi-core CPU test recorded a score of 3505.41, which also ranks in the bottom 25%. Despite these lower compute scores, the Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, and AVX-512 Vector Neural Network Instructions (VNNI), alongside AES cryptography and Intel bit manipulation extensions.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, making it a standard option for workloads that do not require high-performance compute or local disk storage. Given the weak benchmark results, it is best utilized for low-intensity general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, lightweight application hosting, or development and testing environments where CPU throughput is not a primary constraint.
